a11y.apg: No APG pattern: the container is role="log" with aria-live="polite", which is the practice for a conversation — it is read in the order it arrives. This differs from NotificationCenter on purpose: a feed you revisit at your own pace must NOT be a live region. The list itself has nothing focusable; an album brings the Gallery's buttons and a file brings a plain download link, in document order. With the window on (onReachStart or onReachEnd), the list stops being a live region (aria-live="off") — otherwise fifty older messages loaded on top would all be read out — and a separate status reads only the message that arrives at the end, the NotificationCenter idiom.

props.name: messages
props.description: The conversation, as data: {id, body, author?, time?, avatar?, status?}. Transport and state are yours; this renders. Since 0.19 a message may also carry direction ("incoming" | "outgoing"), forwardedFrom, replyTo {id, author?, body}, attachments [{id, kind: "image" | "video" | "file", src?, alt?, name?, bytes?, duration?, href?}], edited and day. Photos and videos become an album in the Gallery (zoom included); files become FileInput's row, with a download link when href is given. A day separator appears whenever day changes from one message to the next; its text is the app's.

props.name: hasMoreBefore
props.description: There are older messages above. A row at the top (the measure of the reference library's load-more table row) calls onReachStart when it enters the screen.

props.name: onReachStart
props.description: Load older messages. When they arrive on top, the message that was at the top of the screen stays exactly where it was. Turns the window on.

props.name: loadingBefore
props.description: Older messages are on their way: the top row shows the Spinner, the list is aria-busy, and onReachStart is not called again until it ends.

props.name: hasMoreAfter
props.description: There are newer messages below that the app dropped to keep its window small (about a thousand). The bottom row calls onReachEnd.

props.name: onReachEnd
props.description: Bring newer messages back. Turns the window on.

props.name: loadingAfter
props.description: Newer messages are on their way: the bottom row shows the Spinner.

props.name: onOpenAttachment
props.description: Called when a photo or video of an album is clicked, instead of the built-in zoom — for a player, or the app's own viewer.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the log region. Name it when a page holds more than one conversation.

props.name: className
props.description: On the container, which is also the live region.
